issues.on_page: Other Capital Outlay (Equipment, Vehicles, Etc.) 27,974.40 in column 1 (2023-24), column 2 (2024-25) and column 3 (2025-26 budget)
issues.issue: The amount is correct as printed, but the same figure in all three columns suggests either a fixed annual installment (lease/purchase or loan payment, which would be debt service) or a figure carried forward on the form. Capital outlay is a defensible category.
